help.text:
Usage: sigma [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  analyze  Analyze Sigma rule sets
  check    Check Sigma rules for validity and best practices (not yet...
  convert  Convert Sigma rules into queries.
  list     List available targets or processing pipelines.
  plugin   pySigma plugin management (backends, processing pipelines and...
  pysigma  pySigma library management commands.
  version  Print version of Sigma CLI.

--backend-option.help: Backend-specific options provided as key=value pair.

--check-pysigma/--no-check-pysigma.help: Check after plugin installation if pySigma version is still matching the CLI requirement.

--compatibility-check/--force-install.help: Enable or disable plugin compatibility check.

--compatibility-check/--no-compatibility.help: Enable or disable plugin compatibility check.

--compatible.help: Show only plugins that are compatible with the installed pySigma version.

--correlation-method.help: Select method for generation of correlation queries. If not given the default method of the backend is used.

--enable-template-vars.help: Enable template variable support in processing pipeline. WARNING: This feature can be dangerous and allow arbitrary code execution if used with untrusted Sigma rules.

--encoding.help: Output encoding for string backend outputs. This is ignored for backends that return binary output.

--exclude.help: List of validators to exclude from the validation. Repeat --exclude for multiple exclusions.

--fail-on-error/--pass-on-error.help: Fail on Sigma rule parsing errors.

--fail-on-issues/--pass-on-issues.help: Fail on Sigma rule validation issues.

--file-pattern.help: Pattern for file names to be included in recursion into directories.

--filter.help: Select filters/exclusions to apply to the rules. Multiple Sigma meta filters can be applied.

--json-indent.help: Pretty-print and indent JSON output with given indentation width per level.

--junitxml.help: Output results in JUnit XML format to the specified file.

--max-score.help: Set fixed maximum score. All scores above are rendered as maximum. Increases color scale resolution for scores below.

--max-time.help: Maximal search time in backend-specific format. Must be supported by backend and output format.

--min-level.help: The minimun level of the rule to be include.

--min-score.help: Minimum score. All scores below are not explicitly colored.

--min-status.help: The minimun status of the rule to be include.

--min-time.help: Minimal search time in backend-specific format. Must be supported by backend and output format.

--output.help: Write result to specified file. '-' writes to standard output. Mutually exclusive with --output-dir.

--output-dir.help: Write individual converted rules to separate files in this directory. Mutually exclusive with --output.

--output-filename-template.help: Template for output filenames when using --output-dir. Available variables: {path} (relative source path), {stem} (filename without extension), {index} (query index for rules that generate multiple queries). Example: '{path}/{stem}-{index}.txt' or 'converted/{stem}.esql'

--pipeline-check/--disable-pipeline-chec.help: Verify if a pipeline is used that is intended for another backend.

--plugin-state.help: Display only plugins with given state.

--plugin-type.help: Display only plugins of given type.

--skip-unsupported/--fail-unsupported.help: Skip conversion of rules that can't be handled by the backend

--target.help: Target backend to use for field name escaping and quoting.

--template-vars-path.help: Allowed paths for template variable expansion. Can be specified multiple times.

--url.help: Override a dataset source in the format dataset:url.

--uuid.help: Report issue in plugin by UUID.

--validation-config.help: Validation configuration file in YAML format.

--without-pipeline.help: Proceed with conversion without processing pipeline, even if it is mandatory for the target.
